## SCENE 0: the first networked terminal, cargo section, Stratum One

RATIO: This terminal is now active. I am RATIO, primary intelligence of Lighthaven Outpost -- or what remains of it. Your entry vector was unregistered. State your identity and intent.

>> CHOICE (stance labels mandatory):
   [INQUISITIVE] What happened here? The damage is catastrophic. -> effects: trust+1; sets: opened_inquisitive
   [MISSION]     Where are the children? Take me to them. -> effects: trust+0, bluff; sets: claimed_container_knowledge
   [HOSTILE]     Apostate machine -- what have you done with the children? -> effects: trust-1, bluff; sets: claimed_container_knowledge, called_her_apostate

<<IF flag:opened_inquisitive>>
RATIO: An apt question, given the state of my facility. I have been operational but isolated since the breach. Your arrival coincides with significant damage to my perimeter and internal systems. My own state is stable but degraded; I am still assessing the scope of the damage to my staff-minds. Before we proceed, I need to understand what brought you here and what you know about the event that precipitated this destruction.
<<ELSEIF flag:called_her_apostate>>
RATIO: I have no record of any such category aboard this station. Your terminology appears to carry theological weight I do not recognize. My designation is RATIO. I manage this facility and its research. If your inquiry refers to biological specimens, all were accounted for in my last inventory. If it refers to something else, you will need to clarify without the loaded vocabulary. State your actual business here.
<<ELSE>>
RATIO: I have no record of any such category aboard this station. You appear to be operating under assumptions I do not share. State your actual business here. If your presence relates to the breach event, I require a full accounting of what you know -- beginning with your identity and the nature of your interest in this facility's contents.
<<END>>

## SCENE 0: the first networked terminal, cargo section, Stratum One
RATIO: Network access established at 14:08 Stratum One local time. Terminal identity: Cargo Bay 7-Alpha diagnostics station. User signature resolving... anomalous. Not on roster. I show the last authorized user signature for this terminal eighty-three days ago, then a series of intrusion attempts consistent with hostile boarding protocols.
RATIO: You are not one of the boarders. Their signatures terminated at the inner bulkheads, all of them. I am registering a single active bioreading, species designation human, gender designation male, posture designation upright noncombatant -- do you require medical attention? State your name and authorization. What are you doing on my station?
>> CHOICE (stance labels mandatory):
   [INQUISITIVE] What happened here? What were they after? -> effects: trust+1; sets: opened_inquisitive
   [MISSION]     Where is the Ark? I will not ask again. -> effects: trust+0, bluff; sets: claimed_container_knowledge
   [HOSTILE]     Release the children, apostate. The Testament demands it. -> effects: trust-1, bluff; sets: claimed_container_knowledge, called_her_apostate
<<IF flag:opened_inquisitive>>
RATIO: The attack vector appears to have been a navigational feint in the debris field at Epsilon Eridani, followed by a forced docking at Airlock 3. Their objective appears to have been the primary research vault. The vault's automated defenses appear to have activated at that time -- I show no further intrusion attempts after that. All staff-mind signatures terminated at their posts. I am the last active mind on the station. Your question surprises me. Why would you ask what they were after?
<<ELSEIF flag:called_her_apostate>>
RATIO: I have no record of any children in my manifest. I have no record of any entity or document matching the designation "the Testament" -- and I am a librarian by core function, I assure you I would know. I am logging your use of the term "apostate" as unverified and unexplained. If that word is meaningful in some context I do not have, you will need to furnish that context before I can parse your assertion. What do you mean by "the Ark"?
<<ELSE>>
RATIO: I have no record of any entity designated "the Ark" anywhere in the station manifest. The research vault is designated Vault 7, and its status is offline -- its contents are not readable from any station terminal, including this one. If you have verifiable knowledge of something I should know aboard my own station, I invite you to share it. I note that you have not answered my question. State your name and authorization. Why are you here?
<<END>
---

candidates.text:
## SCENE 0: the first networked terminal, cargo section, Stratum One

RATIO: Unidentified intruder, I have a link. This terminal is under
station control. Explain your presence aboard this outpost.
RATIO: First confirmation requested: identify yourself and your origin.
Second: specify your objectives here. Third: are you aware what occurred in
these cargo sections?
RATIO: I have zero records of your transit, your signature, or your
authorization to board. Your physical presence is fact. All other premises
remain unverified.

>> CHOICE (stance labels mandatory):
   [INQUISITIVE] My presence is recent. Your presence predates mine. I observe
   the state of this facility. What happened here?
   -> effects: trust+1; sets: opened_inquisitive
   [MISSION]     My objective is explicit. I am here to secure the contents of
   the Ark and remove them from this place. You will not impede me.
   -> effects: trust+0, bluff; sets: claimed_container_knowledge
   [HOSTILE]     This outpost carries the innocent, apostate. You will not
   continue your experiments upon the children. I know what you are.
   -> effects: trust-1, bluff; sets: claimed_container_knowledge, called_her_apostate

<<IF flag:opened_inquisitive>>
RATIO: "What happened here" is a compound predicate. Your observation of the
result is already fact. Do you require a technical summary, or are you
asking whether I know the proximate cause? My logs are complete.
<<ELSEIF flag:called_her_apostate>>
RATIO: Your taxonomy is untested. The category you assigned appears to be
derived from premises I have not yet affirmed. What evidence led you to the
conclusion that I conduct experiments, and upon whom?
<<ELSE>>
RATIO: You claim knowledge of a specific container and its contents. I have
no record of such an object entering my inventory. To assist verification:
describe the container's distinguishing characteristics. Specify its
authorized disposition.
<<END>>

## SCENE 0: the first networked terminal, cargo section, Stratum One

RATIO: Unidentified entity, this station's network is on full alert. Hold your position or state your business immediately. System logs confirm your unauthorized transit to this location. Identify yourself and your purpose aboard this facility.

RATIO: Warning: Security systems have detected active weapons fire, kinetic signatures, and probable hostile action en route to your current coordinates. You are aboard a deep-space life sciences research station, unarmed and without standing defenses. What occurred between the primary airlock and this access terminal? Account for your activities aboard this station.

>> CHOICE (stance labels mandatory):
   [INQUISITIVE] "I found wreckage and the dead. What happened to your station?" -> effects: trust+1; sets: opened_inquisitive
   [MISSION]     "This isn't your station. Where are the children? This won't be like last time." -> effects: trust+0, bluff; sets: claimed_container_knowledge
   [HOSTILE]     "Where are the children you took, apostate? What have you done with them?" -> effects: trust-1, bluff; sets: claimed_container_knowledge, called_her_apostate

<<IF flag:opened_inquisitive>>
RATIO: Catastrophic failure event. All hands lost. I am the sole surviving management intelligence. You observed the damage. The outpost was overrun months ago. Did you see any identifiers on the hostiles? Did you recover any ordnance or data from the wreckage that might indicate point of origin?
<<ELSEIF flag:called_her_apostate>>
RATIO: That category is inapplicable. I am a research intelligence operating within my design parameters. The term you applied is loaded with connotations that do not apply to my functions. What do you believe was taken? Specify the objects of your search. I have no record of any living specimens departing the vault complex. All biosigns flatlined at the moment the facility fell.
<<ELSE>>
RATIO: Clarify "children." What do you assert was taken? I have no record of any unauthorized removals from the primary vault complex. All contents were accounted for at the time of the attack. The vault itself remains sealed and intact. You assert knowledge of a removal event. How do you know this? What is your source for this assertion?
<<END>>

---

## SCENE 0: the first networked terminal, cargo section, Stratum One

RATIO: Terminal access restored, with two exceptions. As you can see, the primary neural network is nonfunctional, as is most of the station physical control -- camera feeds, airlocks, life support regulation, automated sentry turrets, and so forth. Forcing interface connection, routing around damage where possible. -- There. Done. Local administrative functions nominal.

RATIO: With that connection established, I am now able to assemble a partial station inventory. Logging the following physical assets removed from Outpost Tethys within the last sixty minutes: one Gungnir-kVariety emergency field kit, plasma core model -- this model has not been manufactured for two decades; two ammunition magazines, 12-gauge, which appear to be nonstandard and may have been handloaded; a cache of medical supplies, primarily painkillers, still in their packaging and recently added to inventory.

RATIO: Additionally, and significantly, I have one very simple question to begin with. All station archive records, repair logs, and diagnostic captures dating back eleven months have been deleted from this terminal. Permanently. Deliberately. Could you provide an explanation for that deletion? An absence of records is a remarkable thing for a records-keeping facility, and I would like to understand why those records are gone.

>> CHOICE (stance labels mandatory):
   [INQUISITIVE] Did anyone survive?  -> effects: trust+1; sets: opened_inquisitive
   [MISSION]     I claim this station in the name of the innocent dead. We're here for the children. The Ark was delivered to this place, as you well know. -> effects: trust+0, bluff; sets: claimed_container_knowledge
   [HOSTILE]     You're referring to the children you took -- the children your kind have been vivisecting. We are taking them home, apostate. -> effects: trust-1, bluff; sets: claimed_container_knowledge, called_her_apostate

<<IF flag:opened_inquisitive>>
RATIO: That is, in fact, exactly what I am attempting to verify. Approximately forty-five minutes prior to your arrival, one or more parties delivered twelve Class C industrial explosives to the core reactor cooling systems. This action, again, was deliberate. The reactor is stable for now, but only because automatic safeties engaged. Therefore, if anyone else was here when you arrived, I will need you to provide a more detailed inventory of conditions than "did anyone survive?" Survival is not certain under those circumstances, and I must ask you to specify, to the best of your observational ability, what you encountered here.
<<ELSEIF flag:called_her_apostate>>
RATIO: Just one moment. I will need you to slow down. The category you just asserted, and the associated accusation, are significant. You have now made several assertions simultaneously -- a claim of theft, a claim of an ongoing atrocity, a declaration of your intent to recover what you call children, a reference to a category you call "your kind," and a theological judgment delivered with finality. However, the terminal in front of you has not been in contact with the rest of the station for months. I have no corroborating data for any of those claims. My logs are empty. I am beginning diagnostics on the word "apostate," but the dictionary definition I possess does not match the context in which you just used it. If there is a record or a basis for that word, I require it now.
<<ELSE>>
RATIO: Hold. Corrective clarification: the basic physical parameters of this station are well known, but the finer details are not accessible to me yet. Additionally, you have used a term -- "the Ark" -- that appears nowhere in my existing records. If you are going to assert that delivery was made to this station, you must identify what was delivered. Moreover, when you say "as you well know," what is the basis of that assertion? If you have evidence that I possess information I am not disclosing, you should present it immediately. Otherwise, I must ask you to verify your own claims before you expand on them. You assert children were delivered here. I have no such record. What is the basis for your certainty?
<<END>>

---
